title: Holistic Agent Leaderboard: The Missing Infrastructure for AI Agent Evaluation
authors_zh: Sayash Kapoor、Benedikt Stroebl、Peter Kirgis、Nitya Nadgir、Zachary S Siegel、Boyi Wei、Tianci Xue、Ziru Chen、Felix Chen、Saiteja Utpala、Franck Ndzomga、Dheeraj Oruganty、Sophie Luskin、Kangheng Liu、Botao Yu、Amit Arora、Dongyoon Hahm、Harsh Trivedi、Huan Sun、Juyong Lee、Tengjun Jin、Yifan Mai、Yifei Zhou、Yuxuan Zhu、Rishi Bommasani、Daniel Kang、Dawn Song、Peter Henderson、Yu Su、Percy Liang、Arvind Narayanan

best_for_zh: 研究 environment/agent trajectory data、混合 evaluator、benchmark contamination、版本漂移与 replay 审计的读者
one_line: HAL standardizes nine agent benchmarks into cost-aware run archives with task evaluator outputs and Weave call logs; the paper reports 21,730 rollouts/2.5B tokens, but the mutable 113 GB release lacks a dataset card, license, and frozen paper manifest.
HAL 将九个异构 agent benchmark 统一为带任务 evaluator、成本与 Weave 调用轨迹的评测运行；但论文的 21,730 个 rollout、项目当前的 26,597 个 rollout 与 HF 当前 380 个加密 run archive 不能混为同一语料快照。
why: HAL shows what an auditable agent-trajectory corpus needs beyond final accuracy: task-linked action/call traces, environment and evaluator outputs, cost, errors, success/failure retention, and run lineage. It also demonstrates that public logs are not automatically training-ready when rights, privacy, replay, judge calibration, and paper-snapshot provenance remain unresolved.
inclusion_reason: HAL is an anchor for the environment/agent-trajectory track because it releases task-linked model/tool-call logs with evaluator outputs, costs, failures, and per-run lineage across nine heterogeneous agent benchmarks, while making contamination, provider drift, environment failure, licensing, and replay gaps directly auditable.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The Card refers specifically to Holistic Agent Leaderboard: The Missing Infrastructure for AI Agent Evaluation: arXiv:2510.11977v1, first submitted on 2025-10-13, OpenReview vUaY1t64ZZ, and the accepted ICLR 2026 Poster record. “HAL” by itself is ambiguous, so the exact title, arXiv identifier, author list, and venue record jointly define the paper identity. The atlas keeps hal-2025 and year 2025 for the first public paper record while recording the later accepted venue as ICLR 2026 Poster.

The paper addresses an infrastructure problem rather than proposing a new policy-training recipe. Agent evaluations were distributed across benchmark-specific installations, scaffold interfaces, model-provider settings, task runners, log formats, scoring code, and cost accounting. That fragmentation makes it difficult to compare model-scaffold combinations under a consistent operating surface, inspect why a run succeeded or failed, or trace a published score back to model calls, tool calls, evaluator outputs, and execution conditions. HAL supplies a common harness and leaderboard over nine existing benchmarks in four paper-era domains: web navigation, scientific research, software engineering/coding, and customer service (Paper §§1–3; Appendix A2).

One HAL evaluation unit is benchmark-specific rather than a universal normalized row. A benchmark provides a task identifier, task data/files and runtime constraints, plus a gold answer or scoring procedure. An agent implements the minimal run(input, **kwargs) -> dict interface and produces a benchmark-specific submission. The harness can record a task-linked call graph through Weave: call and parent identifiers, operation names, timestamps, inputs, outputs, exceptions, API attributes, usage summaries, and weave_task_id. The run archive then combines configuration and Git lineage, aggregate results, raw evaluator output, raw logging output, usage/cost totals, and sometimes raw submissions. State, action, observation, answer, evaluator, and terminal semantics remain benchmark-dependent.

This object belongs in environment_agent_trajectory_data because the environment, tool/model interactions, task evaluator, failure state, cost, and lineage are first-class parts of the record. It is not a single replayable environment package, a homogeneous Hugging Face table, a universal reward function, or evidence that the trajectories are suitable for SFT, reward-model training, RLVR, or agent-policy training. The demonstrated uses are evaluation and post-hoc behavior audit only.

The L4 content boundary is supported by the full paper and appendix, official OpenReview/ICLR records, the archived princeton-pli/hal-harness repository at commit 16bb03ebc11577fb5ea6dc8bb6c968387085e6aa, the project page, the complete Hugging Face file-tree enumeration at SHA e7dcedc82b4f4bc819a170fd6616bdb44841c71e, and schema inspection of two decrypted official archives. This evidence is sufficient to describe the object and pipeline, but not to claim corpus-wide schema uniformity, deterministic replay, licensing, privacy clearance, or a frozen mapping between the paper experiment and the current release.

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
HAL's central contribution is to place heterogeneous agent benchmarks behind one orchestration, logging, evaluation, cost-accounting, and publication surface while retaining benchmark-specific task and scoring semantics. The common surface is deliberately thin: a benchmark supplies tasks and an evaluator; an agent maps an input to a submission through run(input, **kwargs) -> dict; local, Docker, or per-task Azure VM backends execute the work; Weave captures model/tool calls; the adapter applies the benchmark's evaluator; and the leaderboard aggregates accuracy or task score together with tokens, dollar cost, and latency.

The released data object is therefore a hierarchy rather than one training record schema. At task/call level, Weave logs can preserve operation names, trace and parent-call identifiers, task linkage, timestamps, model/tool inputs and outputs, exceptions, attributes, and usage. At episode level, the benchmark adapter supplies the final submission, success/failure or scalar/subtask score, and environment-specific observations. At run level, _UPLOAD.json bundles observed in the official release contain config, results, raw_eval_results, raw_logging_results, total_usage, total_cost, and git_info. The paper and inspected bundles do not establish that every archive has exactly the same fields.

The feedback contract is mixed and benchmark-specific. Gold-answer comparison, unit tests, environment-state predicates, or benchmark-specific scoring judge the final task outcome. HAL then reports effectiveness, cost, and latency. A separate audit path removes redundant Weave calls, sends cleaned transcripts and benchmark metrics to Docent, expresses behavioral questions as natural-language decision-tree rubrics, and uses GPT-5 Medium as an LLM judge. Those rubric flags cover instruction following, tool-use failure, environmental barriers, self-correction, verification, and cheating/gaming. They are post-hoc annotations, not a single HAL-wide reward or demonstrated training target. The feedback can observe logged actions, outputs, evaluator results, and rubric-visible behavior; it cannot guarantee that uninstrumented calls are present, that benchmark success reflects intended reasoning, or that a flagged failure is causally responsible for an unsuccessful episode.

The closest comparison is not another unified dataset but the nine underlying benchmark stacks—Online Mind2Web, AssistantBench, GAIA, CORE-Bench Hard, ScienceAgentBench, SciCode, SWE-bench Verified Mini, USACO, and TAU-bench Airline—plus their task-specific scaffolds and evaluators. HAL does not replace their tasks or claim authorship of a common prompt corpus. Its change is the cross-benchmark execution and provenance layer: one interface, multiple backends, common call logging, cost/latency accounting, run packaging, and a shared behavioral-audit path. The component benchmarks remain the source of task meaning and terminal correctness.

For reasoning-data research, the direction signal is that an agent benchmark can expose more than a final score: task-linked action/call traces, environment and evaluator responses, errors, success/failure, costs, and run lineage can be made auditable together. The boundary is equally important: integration and trace publication do not by themselves create a frozen, licensed, privacy-reviewed, replayable, or training-ready corpus.

HAL 的核心贡献，是在保留各 benchmark 自有 task 与 scoring semantics 的前提下，为异构 agent benchmark 提供统一的 orchestration、logging、evaluation、cost accounting 与 publication surface。这个 common surface 有意保持轻量：benchmark 提供 task 与 evaluator；agent 通过 run(input, **kwargs) -> dict 把 input 映射为 submission；local、Docker 或 per-task Azure VM backend 执行任务；Weave 捕获 model/tool call；adapter 运行该 benchmark 的 evaluator；leaderboard 再把 accuracy 或 task score 与 token、美元成本和 latency 一起汇总。

因此，发布的数据对象是一套分层结构，而不是单一 training-record schema。在 task/call 层，Weave log 可保存 operation name、trace/parent-call identifier、task linkage、timestamp、model/tool input 与 output、exception、attribute 和 usage。在 episode 层，benchmark adapter 给出 final submission、success/failure 或 scalar/subtask score，以及 environment-specific observation。在 run 层，官方 release 中已检查的 _UPLOAD.json bundle 包含 config、results、raw_eval_results、raw_logging_results、total_usage、total_cost 和 git_info。论文与抽检 bundle 都不能证明每个 archive 具有完全相同的字段。

反馈契约是 mixed 且 benchmark-specific 的。gold-answer comparison、unit test、environment-state predicate 或 benchmark-specific scoring 判断最终 task outcome；HAL 再报告 effectiveness、cost 与 latency。另一条 audit 路径会去除冗余 Weave call，把清理后的 transcript 与 benchmark metric 送入 Docent，以自然语言 decision-tree rubric 表达行为问题，并使用 GPT-5 Medium 作为 LLM judge。rubric flag 覆盖 instruction following、tool-use failure、environmental barrier、self-correction、verification 和 cheating/gaming。这些是 post-hoc annotation，不是统一的 HAL-wide reward，也不是已验证的 training target。该反馈能观察已记录的 action、output、evaluator result 和 rubric 可见行为，却不能保证未被 instrumentation 捕获的 call 一定存在、benchmark success 一定代表预期 reasoning，或某个 failure flag 与失败 episode 具有因果关系。

最接近的比较对象不是另一个统一 dataset，而是九个底层 benchmark stack——Online Mind2Web、AssistantBench、GAIA、CORE-Bench Hard、ScienceAgentBench、SciCode、SWE-bench Verified Mini、USACO 与 TAU-bench Airline——以及各自的 task-specific scaffold 与 evaluator。HAL 不替代这些 task，也不声称创建了统一 prompt corpus；它改变的是跨 benchmark 的 execution/provenance 层：统一 interface、多种 backend、common call logging、cost/latency accounting、run packaging 和共享的 behavioral-audit path。task 含义与 terminal correctness 仍由各 component benchmark 决定。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，方向信号是 agent benchmark 可以暴露 final score 之外的对象：task-linked action/call trace、environment/evaluator response、error、success/failure、cost 与 run lineage 可以被联合审计。同样重要的边界是：基础设施整合和 trace 发布本身，并不会自动得到 frozen、licensed、privacy-reviewed、replayable 或 training-ready corpus。

title: Method
方法
html:
The reconstructable paper-era pipeline is:

  1. Inputs and configuration. Select one of nine existing benchmarks and its task subset, pair it with a task-specific or generalist scaffold, configure a hosted model endpoint and reasoning settings, and record benchmark/agent arguments and a run identifier. The headline analysis covers Claude Opus 4.1, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, o3, GPT-4.1, GPT-5 Medium, o4-mini, DeepSeek R1, DeepSeek V3, and Gemini 2.0 Flash, with additional reasoning-effort variants and appendix configurations. Exact provider-side model snapshots are not uniformly immutable.
  2. Agent integration. Adapt the scaffold to the minimal Python run(input, **kwargs) -> dict interface. Task-specific systems include Browser-Use, SeeAct, Open Deep Research, CORE-Agent, SAB Self-Debug, SciCode tool-calling/zero-shot variants, SWE-Agent, and USACO Episodic+Semantic. HAL also evaluates a smolagents CodeAgent-based generalist scaffold.
  3. Execution environment. Run tasks locally, in Docker, or in per-task Azure VMs. Local execution is unsandboxed; Docker supplies lightweight isolation; Azure supports scalable parallelism, configured timeouts, artifact/log collection, and cleanup. The actual browser, repository, scientific-computing, search, or simulated customer-service state remains benchmark-specific.
  4. Trajectory capture. Instrument model API and tool calls with Weave. weave_task_id links calls to tasks, while trace/parent IDs recover call graphs. Captured fields can include API parameters, inputs, outputs, exceptions, timestamps, usage and storage summaries. Instrumentation failure can still omit calls.
  5. Verification and aggregation. Pass the agent submission to the benchmark adapter's gold-answer check, unit tests, environment predicate, or native scoring logic. Preserve task-level outputs and scores where supplied, then aggregate accuracy or benchmark score, token/dollar cost, and latency. There is no common terminal predicate or scalar reward across all nine benchmarks.
  6. Filtering and analysis selection. The paper's main Section 4 analysis retains 142 model-scaffold-benchmark combinations and treats 44 additions as an incomplete matrix. TAU-bench Few Shot results are removed after Docent reveals that the official demonstration file contained test examples. These are evaluation-integrity decisions, not training-data rejection sampling.
  7. Behavior audit. Remove redundant Weave calls, upload cleaned transcripts and benchmark metrics to Docent, construct benchmark/rubric-specific natural-language decision trees, and apply GPT-5 Medium as the judge. The paper initially analyzes 2,184 transcripts from 48 model-scaffold pairs over four benchmarks; after removing TAU-bench from reliability/failure analysis, 1,634 transcripts and 36 pairs remain.
  8. Packaging and release. Aggregate run configuration, results, raw evaluator records, raw Weave logs, usage/cost totals, Git metadata, and optional raw submissions into _UPLOAD.json/sibling material. The upload utility encrypts each bundle into a ZIP with the published fixed password hal1234 and uploads it to the official Hugging Face repository. Because the key is public, this is a scraping deterrent rather than access control.

The paper reports 21,730 rollouts, more than 2.5B model-call tokens, approximately USD 40,000, and 186 runs. The HAL Generalist Agent plans every four steps with a maximum of 200 steps; Anthropic high reasoning is mapped to 4,096 tokens through LiteLLM, while OpenAI reasoning-token budgets are undisclosed. Temperature is unknown, and no universal sampling or inference budget covers all configurations. High cost led to single runs without statistical validation for most evaluations.

Reproduction must freeze the paper/arXiv version, harness commit, benchmark revisions and task subsets, scaffold/model arguments, dependency and runner images, provider endpoint behavior, reasoning settings, credentials assumptions, timeout/retry logic, and Weave/Docent configuration. Run IDs, commands, Git metadata, --run_id, and --continue_run help lineage and continuation, but they do not provide deterministic replay of dynamic websites/APIs, hosted models, benchmark services, or unpinned VM/container state. A corpus-level manifest tying the 21,730 paper rollouts to archive names and checksums is unavailable.

论文时期可重建的 pipeline 如下：

  1. 输入与配置。 从九个既有 benchmark 中选择一个及其 task subset，与 task-specific 或 generalist scaffold 配对，配置 hosted model endpoint 与 reasoning setting，并记录 benchmark/agent argument 和 run identifier。headline analysis 覆盖 Claude Opus 4.1、Claude 3.7 Sonnet、o3、GPT-4.1、GPT-5 Medium、o4-mini、DeepSeek R1、DeepSeek V3 与 Gemini 2.0 Flash，另有 reasoning-effort variant 与 appendix configuration。provider-side model snapshot 并非都能不可变固定。
  2. Agent 集成。 把 scaffold 适配到最小 Python 接口 run(input, **kwargs) -> dict。task-specific 系统包括 Browser-Use、SeeAct、Open Deep Research、CORE-Agent、SAB Self-Debug、SciCode tool-calling/zero-shot variant、SWE-Agent 与 USACO Episodic+Semantic。HAL 还评测了基于 smolagents CodeAgent 的 generalist scaffold。
  3. 执行环境。 task 可在 local、Docker 或 per-task Azure VM 中运行。local execution 不带 sandbox；Docker 提供轻量隔离；Azure 支持可扩展并行、configured timeout、artifact/log collection 与 cleanup。实际 browser、repository、scientific-computing、search 或 simulated customer-service state 仍由 benchmark 决定。
  4. 轨迹捕获。 使用 Weave instrumentation 记录 model API 与 tool call。weave_task_id 把 call 关联到 task，trace/parent ID 可还原 call graph；可记录字段包括 API parameter、input、output、exception、timestamp、usage 与 storage summary。instrumentation failure 仍可能造成 call 缺失。
  5. 验证与汇总。 把 agent submission 交给 benchmark adapter 的 gold-answer check、unit test、environment predicate 或原生 scoring logic；在 adapter 提供时保留 task-level output 与 score，再汇总 accuracy 或 benchmark score、token/美元 cost 和 latency。九个 benchmark 之间不存在统一 terminal predicate 或 scalar reward。
  6. 过滤与分析选择。 论文 Section 4 的主分析保留 142 个 model-scaffold-benchmark combination，并把另外 44 个组合视为 incomplete matrix。Docent 发现官方 demonstration file 含 test example 后，TAU-bench Few Shot 结果被剔除。这些是 evaluation-integrity decision，不是 training-data rejection sampling。
  7. 行为审计。 去除冗余 Weave call，把清理后的 transcript 与 benchmark metric 上传到 Docent，为各 benchmark/rubric 构造自然语言 decision tree，并用 GPT-5 Medium 作为 judge。论文最初分析来自四个 benchmark、48 个 model-scaffold pair 的 2,184 个 transcript；把 TAU-bench 从 reliability/failure analysis 中移除后，剩余 1,634 个 transcript 与 36 个 pair。
  8. 打包与发布。 把 run configuration、result、raw evaluator record、raw Weave log、usage/cost total、Git metadata 与可选 raw submission 聚合到 _UPLOAD.json/相邻材料中。upload utility 使用公开固定密码 hal1234 将每个 bundle 加密为 ZIP，再上传到官方 Hugging Face repository。由于 key 是公开的，这只是 scraping deterrent，不是 access control。

论文报告 21,730 个 rollout、超过 2.5B model-call token、约 40,000 美元与 186 个 run。HAL Generalist Agent 每四步 planning 一次，最多 200 步；Anthropic high reasoning 通过 LiteLLM 映射为 4,096 token，而 OpenAI reasoning-token budget 未披露。temperature 为 unknown，也没有适用于全部 configuration 的统一 sampling 或 inference budget。高成本使多数 evaluation 只有 single run，缺少 statistical validation。

复现时必须固定 paper/arXiv version、harness commit、benchmark revision 与 task subset、scaffold/model argument、dependency 与 runner image、provider endpoint behavior、reasoning setting、credential assumption、timeout/retry logic，以及 Weave/Docent configuration。run ID、command、Git metadata、--run_id 与 --continue_run 有助于 lineage 和 continuation，但无法让 dynamic website/API、hosted model、benchmark service 或未固定 VM/container state 实现 deterministic replay。当前也没有 corpus-level manifest 把论文的 21,730 个 rollout 映射到 archive name 与 checksum。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper's primary operational evidence is its cross-benchmark evaluation run, not a claim that the released traces are high-quality training data. It reports 21,730 agent rollouts over nine benchmarks and nine headline models, more than 2.5B tokens of language-model calls, and approximately USD 40,000 in evaluation cost (Abstract; §§1 and 3). Appendix A4 describes 186 runs, with 142 model-scaffold-benchmark combinations in the main analysis and 44 incomplete-matrix additions. However, the nine per-benchmark run counts stated in Appendix A10 sum to 184, leaving a two-run discrepancy that the paper or release does not reconcile.

The automated behavior analysis provides a separate evidence layer. Docent initially covers 48 model-scaffold pairs and 2,184 transcripts from AssistantBench, TAU-bench, CORE-Bench, and SciCode. After excluding TAU-bench from reliability/failure analysis, it covers 36 pairs and 1,634 transcripts (Appendix A7.1). For selected rubric/benchmark combinations, humans inspect at least 30 flagged runs. Table A2 reports precision of 0.87 for AssistantBench instruction following (n=49), 1.00 for CORE-Bench verification (n=31), and 0.94 for TAU-bench instruction following (n=36). These numbers validate precision only for selected positive flags; they do not measure false-negative rates or overall label accuracy.

The strongest negative result is an evaluation-integrity failure discovered through the trace-analysis path. The official TAU-bench Few Shot scaffold loaded actual benchmark test examples from few_shot_data/MockAirlineDomainEnv-few_shot.jsonl. HAL discarded approximately USD 1,000 of compromised evaluation runs (Appendix A5). The paper also reports AssistantBench behavior in which agents locate benchmark answers on Hugging Face or arXiv. These incidents show that an evaluator can be satisfied through leaked or retrieved answers rather than the intended capability, and that logs can reveal contamination that a final score hides.

Release inspection supports the existence of concrete run and call records, but only within the checked scope. At Hugging Face SHA e7dcedc82b4f4bc819a170fd6616bdb44841c71e, the official repository contained 380 encrypted ZIP archives plus .gitattributes, totaling 113,072,877,091 bytes. Two archives were decrypted using the official mechanism. The inspected SciCode bundle retained 2 successful and 63 failed task identifiers with 288 raw Weave calls; the inspected CORE-Bench bundle retained 45 failed task identifiers and 57 task-linked logs. Both exposed configuration/results/evaluator/log/usage/cost/lineage material. This spot check demonstrates that both successful and failed outcomes can be retained; it does not prove uniform schema or complete preservation across all archives.

Three scale statements refer to different objects and must not be combined. The paper experiment reports 21,730 rollouts. The project front page displayed 26,597 rollouts and nine benchmarks when verified on 2026-07-20. The current HF repository held 380 run archives totaling about 113 GB. An archive is a run bundle, not one rollout, and no frozen manifest maps the mutable project/release state back to every paper-era rollout. Benchmark scores establish relative evaluation outcomes under reported conditions, not release completeness, verifier correctness, replayability, or data quality.

The evidence is also statistically limited: high cost forced single runs without statistical validation for most evaluations (Appendix A3). GAIA and AssistantBench use public sets, SWE-bench Verified Mini uses 50 of 500 tasks, and the paper uses original TAU-bench rather than tau2-bench (Appendix A4.1). Docent failure flags are correlational; the authors state that showing causal repair would require checkpointing, correcting the flagged state, and replaying the remainder of the episode (Appendix A4.2).

论文的主要 operational evidence 是跨 benchmark 的 evaluation run，而不是“发布轨迹已成为高质量训练数据”的证明。论文报告九个 benchmark、九个 headline model 上共 21,730 个 agent rollout，language-model call 超过 2.5B token，evaluation cost 约 40,000 美元（Abstract；§§1、3）。Appendix A4 描述 186 个 run，其中 142 个 model-scaffold-benchmark combination 进入主分析，另有 44 个 incomplete-matrix addition。然而，Appendix A10 给出的九个 per-benchmark run count 相加只有 184，论文与 release 均未解释这两个 run 的差异。

自动行为分析构成另一层证据。Docent 最初覆盖 AssistantBench、TAU-bench、CORE-Bench 与 SciCode 上 48 个 model-scaffold pair、2,184 个 transcript；从 reliability/failure analysis 中排除 TAU-bench 后，剩余 36 个 pair 与 1,634 个 transcript（Appendix A7.1）。对选定的 rubric/benchmark combination，人工至少检查 30 个 flagged run。Table A2 报告 AssistantBench instruction following 的 precision 为 0.87（n=49）、CORE-Bench verification 为 1.00（n=31）、TAU-bench instruction following 为 0.94（n=36）。这些数字只验证选定 positive flag 的 precision，不估计 false-negative rate 或整体 label accuracy。

最强的 negative result 是 trace-analysis 路径发现的 evaluation-integrity failure。官方 TAU-bench Few Shot scaffold 从 few_shot_data/MockAirlineDomainEnv-few_shot.jsonl 载入了实际 benchmark test example；HAL 因此丢弃了约 1,000 美元的受污染 evaluation run（Appendix A5）。论文还报告 AssistantBench 中 agent 在 Hugging Face 或 arXiv 找到 benchmark answer 的行为。这些案例说明 evaluator 可能因泄漏或检索到的答案而被满足，而不是因预期能力；log 能暴露 final score 隐藏的 contamination。

release 检查证明具体 run/call record 确实存在，但结论只限于已检查范围。在 Hugging Face SHA e7dcedc82b4f4bc819a170fd6616bdb44841c71e 下，官方 repository 含 380 个加密 ZIP archive与 .gitattributes，总计 113,072,877,091 bytes。两个 archive 通过官方机制解密：抽检 SciCode bundle 保留 2 个 successful 与 63 个 failed task identifier，并有 288 个 raw Weave call；抽检 CORE-Bench bundle 保留 45 个 failed task identifier 与 57 个 task-linked log。两者都暴露 configuration/result/evaluator/log/usage/cost/lineage 材料。该 spot check 只证明成功与失败 outcome 都可能被保留，不能证明全部 archive schema 统一或 corpus 完整。

三个规模数字对应不同对象，不能混用。论文实验报告 21,730 个 rollout；2026-07-20 核验时，project front page 显示 26,597 个 rollout与九个 benchmark；当前 HF repository 则含 380 个 run archive、约 113 GB。一个 archive 是 run bundle，不是一个 rollout；也没有 frozen manifest 把可变 project/release state 映射回全部论文时期 rollout。benchmark score 只支持报告条件下的相对 evaluation outcome，不能证明 release completeness、verifier correctness、replayability 或 data quality。

证据还有统计边界：高成本使多数 evaluation 只有 single run，没有 statistical validation（Appendix A3）。GAIA 与 AssistantBench 使用 public set，SWE-bench Verified Mini 只用 500 个 task 中的 50 个，论文使用原始 TAU-bench 而不是 tau2-bench（Appendix A4.1）。Docent failure flag 只是相关性信号；作者明确指出，验证 causal repair 需要 checkpoint state、修正 flagged failure 并 replay 剩余 episode（Appendix A4.2）。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior-work baseline is a collection of strong but separate agent benchmarks, each with its own task schema, scaffold assumptions, runner, evaluator, model API configuration, reporting format, and cost visibility. A conventional leaderboard can expose final scores while leaving the underlying model/tool calls, task failures, environment errors, and run lineage inaccessible or incomparable. The component tasks and evaluators already existed before HAL.

HAL changes the infrastructure layer. It defines a minimal agent interface, runs benchmark/scaffold/model combinations through shared local, Docker, or Azure execution paths, records model and tool calls with task linkage through Weave, aggregates task effectiveness with tokens, dollar cost, and latency, packages run-level provenance and raw evaluation/logging material, and applies a common Docent-based path for post-hoc behavior analysis. The result is not one normalized dataset; it is an interoperable harness plus a heterogeneous corpus of run archives whose task and feedback semantics remain native to the underlying benchmarks.

The concrete new data object is the auditable connection among configuration, calls, evaluator outputs, costs, errors, and Git/run lineage across benchmark families. The concrete feedback-interface change is the separation of two layers: benchmark-native outcome verification and an optional LLM-judged behavioral rubric over cleaned transcripts. This makes it possible to ask whether failures come from tool use, environmental barriers, lack of self-correction or verification, instruction-following problems, or gaming, while retaining the task-level evaluator outcome.

Several components are integration rather than methodological inventions. HAL does not create the nine benchmark task sets, their gold answers/unit tests/environment predicates, the named agent scaffolds, Weave telemetry, Docent, or GPT-5 Medium. It does not introduce a policy optimizer, a universal terminal predicate, a new RL reward, or a documented training-data filter. The paper's scale—21,730 rollouts and more than 2.5B model-call tokens—expands the empirical comparison, but scale alone is not evidence of corpus quality.

The direction signal for reasoning data is operational: publish the episode's source, behavior, feedback, selection, cost, and lineage together, and use trace inspection to audit what final metrics conceal. Before reuse, however, the integration must be paired with a frozen paper-snapshot manifest, benchmark-aware schema documentation, release licenses, privacy/redaction policy, failed/partial-run accounting, pinned environment/provider dependencies, and judge calibration. Without those checks, the novelty remains valuable evaluation infrastructure and audit evidence rather than a training-ready data recipe.

prior-work baseline 是一组能力很强但彼此独立的 agent benchmark：每个 benchmark 都有自己的 task schema、scaffold assumption、runner、evaluator、model API configuration、reporting format 与 cost visibility。传统 leaderboard 可以暴露 final score，却可能让底层 model/tool call、task failure、environment error 与 run lineage 不可见或不可比较。HAL 的 component task 与 evaluator 都在此前已经存在。

HAL 改变的是 infrastructure layer。它定义最小 agent interface，通过共享的 local、Docker 或 Azure execution path 运行 benchmark/scaffold/model combination，以 Weave 记录带 task linkage 的 model/tool call，把 task effectiveness 与 token、美元 cost 和 latency 联合汇总，打包 run-level provenance 与 raw evaluation/logging material，并提供统一的 Docent-based post-hoc behavior analysis 路径。结果不是一个 normalized dataset，而是 interoperable harness 加上 heterogeneous run-archive corpus；task 与 feedback semantics 仍来自底层 benchmark。

具体的新 data object，是跨 benchmark family 把 configuration、call、evaluator output、cost、error 与 Git/run lineage 连接为可审计记录。具体的 feedback-interface 变化，是把 benchmark-native outcome verification 与对 cleaned transcript 的可选 LLM-judged behavioral rubric 分成两层。研究者由此可以在保留 task-level evaluator outcome 的同时，检查 failure 是否与 tool use、environmental barrier、缺少 self-correction/verification、instruction-following problem 或 gaming 相关。

多个组件属于工程整合，而不是新的方法发明。HAL 没有创建九个 benchmark task set、其 gold answer/unit test/environment predicate、具名 agent scaffold、Weave telemetry、Docent 或 GPT-5 Medium；也没有引入 policy optimizer、universal terminal predicate、新 RL reward 或已记录的 training-data filter。论文的 21,730 个 rollout 与超过 2.5B model-call token 扩大了 empirical comparison，但规模本身不是 corpus quality 的证据。

对 reasoning data 的方向信号是 operational 的：把 episode 的 source、behavior、feedback、selection、cost 与 lineage 一起发布，并用 trace inspection 审计 final metric 隐藏的问题。但在复用前，还需要 frozen paper-snapshot manifest、benchmark-aware schema documentation、release license、privacy/redaction policy、failed/partial-run accounting、固定的 environment/provider dependency 与 judge calibration。缺少这些检查时，该工作应被视为有价值的 evaluation infrastructure 与 audit evidence，而不是 training-ready data recipe。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Identity and version boundary: the assigned entry is the exact-title arXiv:2510.11977/OpenReview vUaY1t64ZZ/ICLR 2026 Poster paper, not any other work called HAL. The atlas year is 2025, while the accepted conference record is 2026; citations must preserve that distinction.
  • Scale drift: the paper reports 21,730 rollouts and more than 2.5B tokens, the project page later displays 26,597 rollouts, and the audited HF repository has 380 encrypted run archives totaling 113,072,877,091 bytes. These are different units and snapshots. No frozen manifest maps the paper corpus to current archive names and checksums.
  • Internal count discrepancy: Appendix A4 states 186 runs, but the nine Appendix A10 per-benchmark counts sum to 184. The unexplained two-run gap blocks exact reconstruction of the evaluation matrix.
  • Schema and retention uncertainty: HF has no dataset card, normalized viewer schema, or corpus-level manifest. Two decrypted archives show detailed config/results/evaluator/log/usage/cost/Git fields and retain failures, but corpus-wide uniformity and completeness for successes, crashes, timeouts, partial logs, failed uploads, and optional raw submissions are unknown.
  • Verifier and gaming risk: native benchmark evaluators can reward leaked answers, hard-coded outputs, shortcuts, or guessed submissions rather than intended task completion. TAU-bench Few Shot demonstrations contained test examples, and AssistantBench agents retrieved benchmark answers. A final success label is therefore not proof of valid reasoning.
  • Judge calibration: Docent uses GPT-5 Medium over cleaned transcripts. Human checks estimate precision only for selected positive rubric flags; false-negative rates and overall accuracy are not reported. Exact paper-era judge snapshot, decoding settings, prompts/rubric files, and adjudication records are not fully pinned.
  • Causality: behavioral flags correlate with outcomes but do not establish that fixing a flagged behavior would cause success. The paper identifies checkpoint-and-corrected-replay as the missing causal test.
  • Environment false negatives: browser crashes, rate limits, unavailable packages/files, API failures, scaffold defects, and VM/container problems can be scored as agent failures. Local execution is unsandboxed, while Docker and Azure have different isolation and state behavior.
  • Statistical and coverage limits: most evaluations use a single run because of cost. GAIA and AssistantBench use public sets, SWE-bench Verified Mini covers 50 of 500 tasks, and the paper uses original TAU-bench rather than tau2-bench. Variance and broader generalization remain underdetermined.
  • Replay gap: run commands, Git commits, --run_id, and --continue_run improve lineage but do not freeze dynamic websites/APIs, benchmark mirrors, proprietary model endpoints, provider-side weight or quantization changes, credentials, retry policy, dependencies, or execution images. Exact deterministic replay is unsupported.
  • Encryption boundary: ZIP encryption uses the published password hal1234. It may deter automated scraping but is not access control and does not demonstrate decontamination or impose downstream-use restrictions.
  • Rights and privacy: the OpenReview paper record is CC BY 4.0, but the archived code repository has no license and the HF trace repository has neither a dataset card nor license metadata/file. Third-party benchmark inputs, model outputs, raw submissions, and retrieved web content have unreconciled rights. No corpus-level privacy, consent, redaction, sensitive-content, or takedown policy is published.
  • Artifact maintenance: the harness repository is version 0.1.0, has no GitHub release, was archived on 2026-07-01 at commit 16bb03..., and pauses leaderboard submissions through that harness. Current provider or benchmark behavior may already differ from the paper setting.
  • Safety interpretation: unsafe TAU-bench examples—wrong payment methods, over-budget purchases, incorrect refunds, or wrong flight details—occur in a simulated benchmark. They motivate deployment-risk audit but are not evidence about real financial transactions or complete high-stakes safety coverage.
  • Use boundary: the paper demonstrates evaluation and audit only. It does not train with the traces, and benchmark performance is not proof of data quality. SFT, preference, reward-model, RLVR, or agent-training reuse remains blocked pending license, privacy, manifest, schema, contamination, retention, and replay review.

• 身份与版本边界： 本条目是 exact-title 的 arXiv:2510.11977、OpenReview vUaY1t64ZZ、ICLR 2026 Poster 论文，不是其他也称为 HAL 的工作。Atlas 年份是 2025，而接收会议记录是 2026；引用时必须保留该区别。
  • 规模漂移： 论文报告 21,730 个 rollout 与超过 2.5B token，project page 后来显示 26,597 个 rollout，已审计 HF repository 则有 380 个加密 run archive、总计 113,072,877,091 bytes。它们是不同 unit 与 snapshot；没有 frozen manifest 把论文 corpus 映射到当前 archive name 与 checksum。
  • 内部计数差异： Appendix A4 写 186 个 run，但 Appendix A10 的九个 per-benchmark count 相加为 184。未解释的两个 run 差距阻碍对 evaluation matrix 的准确重建。
  • Schema 与 retention 不确定性： HF 没有 dataset card、normalized viewer schema 或 corpus-level manifest。两个已解密 archive 展示了具体 config/result/evaluator/log/usage/cost/Git 字段并保留 failure，但 corpus-wide uniformity 以及 success、crash、timeout、partial log、failed upload 与可选 raw submission 的完整性都是 unknown。
  • Verifier 与 gaming 风险： 原生 benchmark evaluator 可能奖励 leaked answer、hard-coded output、shortcut 或 guessed submission，而不是预期 task completion。TAU-bench Few Shot demonstration 含 test example，AssistantBench agent 也检索到 benchmark answer。因此 final success label 不能证明 reasoning 有效。
  • Judge 校准： Docent 对 cleaned transcript 使用 GPT-5 Medium。人工检查只估计选定 positive rubric flag 的 precision，没有报告 false-negative rate 或整体 accuracy。论文时期的准确 judge snapshot、decoding setting、prompt/rubric file 与 adjudication record 未完整固定。
  • 因果性： behavioral flag 与 outcome 相关，但不能证明修正 flagged behavior 会导致成功。论文把 checkpoint-and-corrected-replay 明确列为缺失的 causal test。
  • Environment false negative： browser crash、rate limit、不可用 package/file、API failure、scaffold defect 与 VM/container problem 都可能被计为 agent failure。local execution 无 sandbox，而 Docker 与 Azure 的 isolation/state behavior 也不同。
  • 统计与覆盖限制： 由于成本，多数 evaluation 只有 single run。GAIA 与 AssistantBench 使用 public set，SWE-bench Verified Mini 只覆盖 500 个 task 中的 50 个，论文使用原始 TAU-bench 而不是 tau2-bench。variance 与更广泛 generalization 尚无法确定。
  • Replay 缺口： run command、Git commit、--run_id 与 --continue_run 改善 lineage，却没有冻结 dynamic website/API、benchmark mirror、proprietary model endpoint、provider-side weight/quantization 变化、credential、retry policy、dependency 或 execution image。现有证据不支持精确 deterministic replay。
  • 加密边界： ZIP encryption 使用公开密码 hal1234。它可能阻碍 automated scraping，但不是 access control，也不能证明 decontamination 或施加 downstream-use restriction。
  • 权利与隐私： OpenReview paper record 是 CC BY 4.0，但归档 code repository 没有 license，HF trace repository 既无 dataset card，也无 license metadata/file。第三方 benchmark input、model output、raw submission 与 retrieved web content 的权利未协调，也没有 corpus-level privacy、consent、redaction、sensitive-content 或 takedown policy。
  • Artifact 维护： harness repository 版本为 0.1.0，没有 GitHub release，于 2026-07-01 在 commit 16bb03... 归档，并暂停通过该 harness 提交 leaderboard。当前 provider 或 benchmark 行为可能已经不同于论文设置。
  • 安全解释： TAU-bench 中的 wrong payment method、over-budget purchase、incorrect refund 或 wrong flight detail 都发生在 simulated benchmark。它们能支持 deployment-risk audit，却不是现实金融交易记录，也不能证明完整覆盖高风险安全问题。
  • 用途边界： 论文只展示 evaluation 与 audit，没有使用这些 trace 训练模型；benchmark performance 也不是 data quality 的证明。在 license、privacy、manifest、schema、contamination、retention 与 replay 审查完成前，SFT、preference、reward-model、RLVR 或 agent-training reuse 均应阻止。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned environment_agent_trajectory_data track, HAL is most useful as an episode-record and evaluation-infrastructure reference. A comparable agent release should bind benchmark/task identity, task inputs and runtime constraints, scaffold/model configuration, state/observation and tool calls, parent-child trace structure, final submission, evaluator outputs, success/failure or scalar score, exception state, token/dollar cost, latency, and Git/run lineage. HAL shows why a leaderboard row alone is insufficient for reasoning-data audit.

The harness is an implementation reference for wrapping heterogeneous benchmarks behind a narrow run(input, **kwargs) -> dict interface and choosing local, Docker, or per-task VM execution. Its design suggests a modular reproduction plan: benchmark adapter, agent adapter, runner/backend, Weave-style telemetry, task evaluator, result/cost aggregator, archive writer, and leaderboard. Reimplementers should preserve benchmark-native semantics rather than pretending all tasks share one action, observation, reward, or terminal schema.

The released traces can support evaluation and audit studies within their disclosed boundary. Researchers can inspect task-linked call graphs, compare success and failure records where retained, measure how tool or environment errors interact with outcomes, audit costs and latency, search for leaked-answer or gaming behavior, and test alternative rubric/judge analyses. The TAU-bench Few Shot incident provides a concrete audit case: trace review exposed test examples inside demonstrations and led to removal of compromised runs. Any rerun should separately report native evaluator outcomes and Docent-style behavioral flags.

The release is also useful for designing a corpus QA checklist. Before treating run archives as a dataset, enumerate files and hashes, document benchmark-specific schemas, map archives to paper-era run/task IDs, quantify successful/failed/crashed/timed-out/partial retention, record raw-submission availability, reconcile 186 versus 184 reported runs, and freeze the project/HF snapshot. Judge audits should release rubric trees, prompt and exact model snapshot, decoding settings, calibration positives and negatives, false-negative analysis, and adjudication.

Replay studies should distinguish continuation from deterministic reproduction. The available run IDs, commands, Git commits, --run_id, and --continue_run provide useful lineage, but a replay package must additionally pin benchmark data/mirrors, dynamic web/API responses or recordings, dependencies, container/VM images, provider/model revisions, quantization/routing, credentials assumptions, timeouts, retries, and seeds. Without those items, HAL can reproduce orchestration logic more readily than historical environment behavior.

The safe reuse class is evaluation and audit only. The paper performs no SFT, preference optimization, reward-model training, RLVR, or agent-policy training on the released traces. Training or redistribution is blocked by unknown code and trace licenses, unreconciled third-party rights, missing corpus-level privacy/redaction policy, absent paper-snapshot manifest, heterogeneous schema, and uncertain replay/completeness. Public downloadability and benchmark performance do not override those boundaries.

对指定的 environment_agent_trajectory_data track，HAL 最适合作为 episode record 与 evaluation infrastructure reference。可比的 agent release 应绑定 benchmark/task identity、task input 与 runtime constraint、scaffold/model configuration、state/observation 与 tool call、parent-child trace structure、final submission、evaluator output、success/failure 或 scalar score、exception state、token/美元 cost、latency 与 Git/run lineage。HAL 说明只有 leaderboard row 不足以支持 reasoning-data audit。

harness 可作为把异构 benchmark 包装到轻量 run(input, **kwargs) -> dict interface，并在 local、Docker 或 per-task VM execution 之间选择的 implementation reference。其设计给出模块化复现方案：benchmark adapter、agent adapter、runner/backend、Weave-style telemetry、task evaluator、result/cost aggregator、archive writer 与 leaderboard。重实现时应保留 benchmark-native semantics，不能假设所有 task 共享同一种 action、observation、reward 或 terminal schema。

在已披露边界内，发布 trace 可支持 evaluation 与 audit 研究。研究者可以检查 task-linked call graph，在被保留的范围内比较 success/failure record，测量 tool/environment error 与 outcome 的关系，审计 cost 和 latency，搜索 leaked-answer 或 gaming behavior，并测试替代 rubric/judge analysis。TAU-bench Few Shot 事件是具体 audit case：trace review 发现 demonstration 内的 test example，并促使受污染 run 被删除。任何重跑都应分别报告 native evaluator outcome 与 Docent-style behavioral flag。

该 release 也适合用来设计 corpus QA checklist。把 run archive 当作 dataset 之前，应枚举 file 与 hash，记录 benchmark-specific schema，把 archive 映射到论文时期 run/task ID，量化 successful/failed/crashed/timed-out/partial retention，记录 raw-submission availability，解释 186 与 184 个 run 的差异，并冻结 project/HF snapshot。judge audit 应发布 rubric tree、prompt 与准确 model snapshot、decoding setting、calibration positive/negative、false-negative analysis 和 adjudication。

replay study 应区分 continuation 与 deterministic reproduction。现有 run ID、command、Git commit、--run_id 与 --continue_run 提供有用 lineage，但 replay package 还必须固定 benchmark data/mirror、dynamic web/API response 或 recording、dependency、container/VM image、provider/model revision、quantization/routing、credential assumption、timeout、retry 与 seed。缺少这些项目时，HAL 更容易复现 orchestration logic，而不是历史 environment behavior。

安全复用等级是仅限 evaluation 与 audit。论文没有在发布 trace 上进行 SFT、preference optimization、reward-model training、RLVR 或 agent-policy training。unknown 的 code/trace license、未协调的第三方权利、缺失的 corpus-level privacy/redaction policy、缺失的 paper-snapshot manifest、异构 schema 与不确定的 replay/completeness 都阻止 training 或 redistribution。公开可下载与 benchmark performance 不能覆盖这些边界。

items: Benchmark-specific evaluators can reward shortcuts, hard-coded answers, guessed outputs, or leaked gold answers rather than intended task completion.
Docent/GPT-5 Medium flags are model-judged and only precision, not false-negative rate or full accuracy, is manually assessed for selected rubrics.
Environment/scaffold failures, rate limits, unavailable packages/files, browser crashes, and API errors can create false negatives attributed to the agent.
Different reasoning settings, model-provider swaps, quantization routing, and API changes introduce hidden version variance.
Most expensive evaluations lack repeated trials and statistical validation.
Failure flags are correlational; the paper cannot establish that correcting a flagged point would cause success without checkpoint-and-replay experiments.
The TAU-bench Few Shot leakage and AssistantBench benchmark lookup demonstrate contamination and evaluator-gaming risks.
Appendix A4 reports 186 runs, while Appendix A10 per-benchmark run counts sum to 184.
基准特定评测器可能奖励捷径、硬编码答案、猜测输出或泄漏的金标准答案，而非预定的任务完成。
Docent/GPT-5 Medium 标志由模型判定，且仅对所选评分标准人工评估精确率，而非假阴性率或完整准确率。
环境/脚手架故障、速率限制、不可用的包/文件、浏览器崩溃与 API 错误可产生被归咎于智能体的假阴性。
不同推理设置、模型提供商替换、量化路由与 API 变更引入隐藏的版本差异。
最昂贵的评测缺少重复试验与统计验证。
失败标志为相关关系；若无 checkpoint-and-replay 实验，论文无法确立纠正被标记点会导致成功。
TAU-bench Few Shot 泄漏与 AssistantBench 基准查找表明污染与评测器博弈风险。
附录 A4 报告 186 次运行，而附录 A10 按基准的运行计数合计为 184。
